Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare and cleaning products.
Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the
industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home
improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio
includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® – recognized worldwide for
their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior
quality. The company maintains a global manufacturing and product
development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately
US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring
exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a
high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and
helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we
serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our
acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer
expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage
that powers our growth. To strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart
area) as soon as possible, we are looking for a Sustainability Data
Analyst (f/m/d) Your role: Collaborate with business stakeholders and
leadership teams to gather requirements, develop, and support data
modelling and BI solutions for organizational stakeholders Integrate
different data sources into a cohesive data fabric, ensuring data
consistency, accuracy and reliability Conduct business analysis
activities to understand business user requirements and translate data
and information flows within business processes Analyze
sustainability, quality and regulatory data to identify trends,
patterns and areas for improvement Provide insights and
recommendations based on data analysis to support informed
decision-making in sustainability initiatives Perform data profiling,
validation and cleaning to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality
of enterprise data Maintain data quality standards and enforce data
governance policies, standards and best practices Maintain clear
documentation for data orchestrations, highlighting their value and
contribution to improved data modeling and governance Your profile:
Bachelor's or similar degree in Data Science, Environmental Science,
Sustainability Management, or a related field, or equivalent
professional experience Proven experience with Power BI, Power
Automate, VBA, C++ programming, Python, and SAP QuickViewer Good
communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken
Knowledge of Qlik Sense and IBM Envizi is considered an advantage
Relevant experience in data analysis, reporting, and data
visualization Your perks: An interesting position with an attractive
company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu Free parking
spaces directly next to the office and good public transport
connections Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for free Company
fitness via "EGYM Wellpass” Bicycle leasing via "JobRad” EAP
(mental support for employees) Learning platforms such as
"GoodHabitz” and "Learn TTI” for your professional development
Special employee benefits via "Family & Friends” and additional
corporate benefit Are you interested? Then send your application via
our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your application with the
utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to know you! Techtronic
Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources – Agnese Cesarini ·
Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden

Job Description EuroChem is one of the leading manufacturers of
fertilizers, with a long-standing presence in Europe and many
countries overseas. With our broad product portfolio, we offer plant
nutrition solutions for every application, including field
fertilization, fertigation, and foliar fertilization. The Supply &
Operations Planning Manager is a central integrator between the
production site and the regional and local Sales organizations. As
part of the regional team in Mannheim, you take full responsibility
for demand planning, supply balancing, and commercial scenario
development for a defined product group and/or a specific production
site in Europe. We are looking for a committed and experienced: Supply
& Operations Planning Manager (m/w/d) Your Key Responsibilities in
detail: Lead S&OP Planning for a Defined Product Portfolio or
Production Site Own the end-to-end S&OP planning cycle for your
assigned products/sites, ensuring a robust, transparent and efficient
planning process while balancing the interdependencies of continuous
fertilizer production, customer service, production stability,
logistics constraints, working capital and financial performance
Integrate commercial priorities into the planning process by
evaluating business opportunities, optimizing contribution margins,
prioritizing markets and ensuring the optimal deployment of
constrained production capacities Facilitate commercial
decision-making in close collaboration with the Commercial Lead
(responsible for the production site or the European commercial
organization) Commercial & Operational Planning Validate demand
forecasts, evaluate commercial opportunities, identify supply gaps or
surpluses and align production capabilities with Sales Managers and
the Commercial Lead Allocation & prioritization: Define & adjust
product allocations and market priorities (planned product volume/
price-positions) in close collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain
Execution to establish delivery commitments and operational priorities
Support working capital optimization by incorporating Order-to-Cash
(OTC) cycle-time considerations into planning decisions using sales
input and historical performance data Inventory, Production & Shipment
Monitoring Tracking regional inventory targets to balance service
levels, production stability and capital efficiency Monitor the
Production–Shipment Plan (actual vs. planned performance), identify
deviations early and initiate necessary corrective actions, such as
accelerated delivery or reallocation of volumes Your Qualification:
Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial
Engineering or comparable field 2 to 5 years professional work
experience in Supply Chain Planning would be an advantage Strong
analytical and commercial thinking skills; ability to balance
trade-offs and drive decisions Structured, proactive and hands-on
approach in dynamic environments Very good communication and
stakeholder management skills High IT affinity; strong Excel skills;
experience with S&OP planning tools is a plus Fluent English (written
and spoken); additional languages are beneficial Enjoy working in a
collaborative, supportive team culture Kontakt Like to work
independently and on your own responsibility? Entrepreneurial thinking
and acting is a matter of course for you? Then we should get to know
each other! Please send your detailed CV in English to Human
Resources, attention Andreas Wagner Andreas.Wagner@eurochem.group

business cases for the development of the European warehouse footprint

rework and scrapping activities to track financial impacts and
identify risks and opportunities Projects & process improvements:
participate in international and cross-functional projects with a
focus on enhancing controlling processes, reporting standards, and
digital tools Leadership exposure: collaborate closely with the

stakeholder management, and strategic decision-making processes Your

business partnering role, ideally in an international environment
Business analytical skills, interest in numbers and data, and the
expertise to translate financial insights into business
recommendations Competent knowledge of Excel and BI tools; SAP
knowledge as a plus Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented
working style combined with collaboration skills Communication and
stakeholder management skills across different organizational levels
Interest in taking on additional responsibility and developing toward

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,
detail-oriented and experienced Senior HR Manager (m/f/d) to join our
team in Berlin. This role will be responsible for leading key people,
compliance, and governance activities across the employee lifecycle,
ensuring that HR practices are legally compliant, operationally
effective, and aligned with organisational objectives. Acting as a
trusted advisor to managers and employees, the role provides expert
guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and
European regulations while promoting a safe, healthy, and engaging
workplace. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external
partners, and legal advisors, the Senior HR Manager identifies and
mitigates people-related risks, maintains strong governance
frameworks, and contributes to a positive employee experience across
the organisation. This position is ideal for an experienced HR
professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements
where applicable. Manage employee relations cases, including
disciplinary procedures, grievances, performance-related matters, and
workplace concerns. Partner with external legal advisors when
required. Compliance, Audits & Risk Management Conduct regular
internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR
operations-focused role. Strong knowledge of German labour law,
employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements. Experience
managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven
experience conducting HR audits and implementing compliance
initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data
management. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing
organization. Previous involvement in HR transformation, process
improvement, or digitalization projects. Experience working with audit
frameworks, compliance reviews, and risk management processes. Key
Competencies Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential
information. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
Strong project management and organisational skills. Collaborative and
customer-focused approach. What We Offer Opportunity to shape and
improve HR operations in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and
international team culture. Professional development and learning
opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexible
working arrangements. A people-first workplace focused on inclusion,
wellbeing, and growth. Equal Opportunity Statement We celebrate
diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for
all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all
backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are dedicated to
ensuring equal opportunities throughout the

WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).
